crossRefs.note: Even all the nations will say, “Why has Yahweh done this to this land? What does the heat of this great anger mean?”
Behold, the enemy will come up like a lion from the pride of the Jordan against the strong habitation; for I will…
Therefore hear the counsel of Yahweh, that he has taken against Babylon; and his purposes, that he has purposed against…
Therefore in one day her plagues will come: death, mourning, and famine; and she will be utterly burned with fire; for…
“Son of man, tell the prince of Tyre, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “Because your heart is lifted up, and you have said, ‘I am…
“Son of man, take up a lamentation over the king of Tyre, and tell him, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “You were the seal of…
For he says, “Aren’t all of my princes kings?
How then can you turn away the face of one captain of the least of my master’s servants, and put your trust on Egypt…

people.name: Tyre
people.line: A major Phoenician port city, known for its trade

translations.web: Who has planned this against Tyre, the giver of crowns, whose merchants are princes, whose traders are the honorable of the earth?
translations.bsb: Who planned this against Tyre, the bestower of crowns, whose traders are princes, whose merchants are renowned on the earth?
translations.kjv: Who hath taken this counsel against Tyre, the crowning city, whose merchants are princes, whose traffickers are the honourable of the earth?
translations.asv: Who hath purposed this against Tyre, the bestower of crowns, whose merchants are princes, whose traffickers are the honorable of the earth?
